# Cygnix SEO MCP

> Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) by Cygnix Labs with SEO and AI-search tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code: AEO / AI-search readiness checks, keyword cannibalization from Search Console exports (live Search Console connection coming soon), llms.txt validation, keyword clustering, search intent, title/meta checks, content briefs, and white-label PDF reports for agencies. Free tier with 300 calls a month; Pro $15, Growth $39, Agency $99 per month.

## Docs

- [Connect guide](https://mcp.cygnixlabs.com/connect.html): copy-paste setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code
- [Pricing](https://mcp.cygnixlabs.com/#pricing): Free, Pro, Growth and Agency plans and quotas
- [Source and local stdio version](https://github.com/cygnixlabs-cmd/cygnix-seo-mcp): open-source repo and the `npx cygnix-seo-mcp` package
